packageRules.description: test/ and examples/ are scanned only so the Go toolchain image stays in sync; keep their other deps unmanaged as before
...but keep the digests of their pinned images fresh (same tag, rebuilt image): Dockerfile base images and the e2e tests' imageOr defaults
Bump the go directive on patch releases too (the default treats it as a minimum and never moves it)
Ship the go directive and every Dockerfile's ARG GO_IMAGE (golang tag + digest, updated together by the dockerfile manager) in one PR; make go-version-check fails if they drift

customManagers.description: Digest-pinned images outside Dockerfiles: the e2e tests' imageOr("E2E_..._IMAGE", "image:tag@sha256:...") defaults and images passed to workflow action inputs (e.g. buildkit-cache-dance's utility-image)
